messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - inference-prod: elevated 500s and timeouts for text-generation in us-west-2. Amplitude: 18% failure rate baseline->now. Paging Nadia (oncall).

Nadia (oncall): on it. pulling logs + metrics, will flip traffic to fallback-model-v2 if errors persist. ETA 5m to confirm mitigation.

Ethan (sre-lead): Nadia pls capture exact window for SLA calc. Also tag any affected customer orgs we can find from request headers.

Nadia (oncall): got the initial error burst around 1968075280 -> 1968075400 UTC. spikes correlate with long-seq requests (seq>1024). Starting rollout of fallback-model-v2 now (gradual 10% -> 100%).

Priya (pm): quick Q — do we have an existing policy re: automatic SLA credit thresholds for >10% error for >5m? Trying to draft status page wording.

Sam (billing): we treat >5m service-affecting incident with material customer impact as eligible, but need concrete list of affected customers + their usage buckets. Nadia, can you paste top 10 tenant ids hitting errors?

Nadia (oncall): top tenants (anonymized): tenant_42, tenant_91, tenant_13, tenant_77. Filtering now for token counts per tenant.

Carla (support): tagging. I'll prepare a proactive customer note draft for the top 3 tenants and hold until we confirm impact window. Who should be sender? ops@redwood-inference.com or account rep?

Priya (pm): send initial holding message from ops@redwood w/ note that we're investigating, will follow up with impact summary and compensation if eligible. Keep it short.

Nadia (oncall): mitigation reduced errors to 1.6% after routing to fallback-model-v2 at ~1968075355. Rolling back traffic to primary only after 15m stable.

Ethan (sre-lead): nice. log snippet showing the rollback command we used for runbook reference:
```
# scale down primary pool quickly
redwood-cli route set --service inference-prod --model fallback-model-v2 --weight 1.0 --region us-west-2
# monitor
redwood-cli metrics tail --service inference-prod --metric 5xx_rate --region us-west-2
```

Nadia (oncall): capturing timeline in incident doc. Will include start/mitigation/restore timestamps and the list of affected tenants + sample request IDs.

Priya (pm): draft status page update (please review/edit):
"We are investigating elevated errors for the text-generation endpoint in us-west-2 affecting a subset of requests. Mitigation applied by routing traffic to a compatible model variant which reduced errors. Service restored; we are continuing to monitor. Detailed customer impact and next steps will be provided in a follow-up."

Sam (billing): wording looks good. For SLA credits we need: 1) incident window (start/restore), 2) list of customers with affected request volume, 3) estimated eligible credit per billing policies. I'll own the credit calc once Nadia drops the tenant volumes.

Carla (support): customer holding note (short):
"Hi — we experienced elevated errors for inference requests in US-WEST-2 earlier today. We mitigated the issue by routing traffic to a compatible model variant; service is restored. We'll follow up with a full impact summary and any applicable SLA credit information. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Ops" :memo:

Nadia (oncall): dropping data now: tenant_42: 18k tokens affected, tenant_91: 7.4k, tenant_13: 2.1k, tenant_77: 540. Full CSV uploaded to /incidents/1968075301/artifacts/tenant-impact.csv (ops-bot confirmed upload).

ops-bot: artifact uploaded: /incidents/1968075301/artifacts/tenant-impact.csv (sha256: abc123...)

Sam (billing): received file. I'll run the credit calc against monthly commitments + per-token rates and post numbers by EOD. Need one owner to approve sending customer compensation offer.

Ethan (sre-lead): postmortem action items: - investigate long-seq handling for primary kernels - add an automatic small-traffic fallback policy when 5xx_rate>8% for >3m - add alert to correlate long-seq mix ratio with errors.

Priya (pm): I'll own customer comms follow-up with Carla and Sam. Plan: 1) send detailed impact summary + credit calc, 2) offer direct contact for questions, 3) update status page with final postmortem link.

Nadia (oncall): marking incident resolved in oncall dashboard. thumbs up for handoff to post-incident stream. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P1 closed by Nadia (oncall) at 1968075598. Follow-up tasks created: INC-1968075301 (postmortem), COMP-1968075301 (credit calc).

Carla (support): will queue customer emails and run by Priya + Sam before send. Thanks everyone. :wave:
